'''GAD-3''' was a [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] that worked on the [[Odionate|Odionite]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[The Spike (space station)|The Spike]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Charge Matrica|second ''Charge Matrica'']].

==Biography==
In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], GAD-3 was reprogrammated by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] during her [[Raid on The Spike|mission]] to The Spike and he helped her to damage the station. After Kerra ordered him to open the containment fields, he along with several droids and at least one [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] crew-member were subsequently sucked into zero gravity space and presumably decompressed.

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
GAD-3 appears solely as a minor supporting antagonist in [[Knight Errant 3|''Knight Errant: Aflame'' 3]]&mdash;part of the [[Star Wars: Knight Errant (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knight Errant'']] comic series&mdash; which was released on [[December 8]], [[2010]]. [[John Jackson Miller]] developed his story background while he was drawn by [[Ivan Rodriguez]] and colored by [[Michael Atiyeh]].
